name: Faithful Adjutant (Marshal Archetype)
body:
These marshals eschew tactics and combat alone and attune themselves to higher faiths, deities, or other philosophies. They then share this with their allies to bolster their bonds and bodies alike.

Gracious Inspiration (Ex)

A faithful adjutant does not use their force of personality to inspire and instead relies on their faith and mentorship. Faithful adjutants use Wisdom in place of Charisma for all marshal abilities that refer to Charisma.

Channel Positive Energy (Su)

At 2nd level, a faithful adjutant gains the ability to channel positive energy, as a cleric of their class level regardless of their alignment.

This ability replaces vital inspiration, triple aura, expanded aura, and quadruple aura.

Meditative Mentor (Ex)

Faithful adjutants don’t rely on drill training and sharing the typical skills of other marshals. Instead, they instill a greater sense of self and faith in higher energies within their allies. At 4th level, a faithful adjutant gains Meditation Master and Combat Meditation feats as bonus feats without needing to meet their prerequisites and a faithful adjutant may share these feats with their allies. As a standard action, the marshal can grant all meditation feats they possess to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear them, and allies are considered to have meditated when these feats are gained. Allies retain the use of these feats for 3 rounds plus 1 round for every two class levels the faithful adjutant possesses. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats. A faithful adjutant can use this ability once per day at 4th level, plus one additional time per day at 8th level and for every 4 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces tactician.

Bonus Meditation Feat (Ex)

At 8th level and again at 16th level, a faithful adjutant gains a bonus meditation feat. From 8th level onward, the faithful adjutant may ignore other feats listed in the prerequisites of meditation feats but must still meet the Wisdom and character level requirements.

This ability replaces the bonus teamwork feats gained at 8th and 16th levels.

Greater Meditative Mentor (Ex)

At 12th level, a faithful adjutant gains an additional bonus meditation feat for which they meet the prerequisites and may now activate the meditative mentor ability as a swift action.

This ability replaces greater tactician.

Master of Meditation (Ex)

At 20th level, a faithful adjutant gains two additional bonus meditation feats for which they meet the prerequisites and are no longer limited in how many times per day they may share their meditation feats.
